== Notes ==
* Despite the full description, reapplying a condition you are already suffering from triggers Contagion again (except for the burning via [[Soul Ignition]]).
* Combines well with [[Condition#Skills_which_inflict_conditions_on_oneself|skills which inflict conditions on oneself]].
* May be used with skills that benefit from sacrifice like [[Masochism (PvP)]] and [[Dark Aura]].
* This skill is commonly used by [[Saccer]]s to force-trigger [[Death Nova]].
* The condition does not spread  if it was transferred to your minion through [[Infuse Condition]].
